hiddenPageLinks.why: acm/slideshow/tmpl/style-owl.php prints each slide with div.slide-action holding two buttons to inner pages (module-94 btn-link1 and btn-link2: the about page and the reservation page; module-94.12 and .13 are kept slots), so a plan that drops one of those pages leaves a slide button leading to a hidden page

acm/features-intro/tmpl/style-1.php prints each feature row with div.feature-action holding the row link data.btn-link (module-95: the reservation and contact pages), so a plan that drops one of those pages leaves a row link leading to a hidden page

legal.why: html/com_content/article/ holds one article file, default.php (with its default_links.php part), which prints the article alone; no content page of the template prints through a file of its own, so the component default is that plain file
